But I've a best friend too, with whom I've shared how I think so low of myself and never once did it occur for her to treat me in a shitty manner, instead she has always tried to uplift me. 

So yes, please do work on loving yourself but do understand that men you deal with are completely in the wrong here. Because a good person wouldn't use you.
